verdict.rationale: Skills are instruction packages, not an automation runtime. They can only run in the background by riding on adjacent Claude Code and Agent SDK infrastructure: background sessions viewed through `claude agents`, and SDK agents that load skills and plugins programmatically, with Claude auto-loading relevant skills. Skills themselves have no documented scheduling, triggers or unattended execution, and community reports say Claude often fails to invoke skills on its own without explicit prompting. Missing for 10: native scheduling or event triggers for skills, documented background or unattended skill execution, and independent hands-on evidence of skills running autonomously.
